items.name: EL4CTEO/fast-anything
items.description: Don't rewrite it in Rust. Rewrite the 5% that's slow: profile your app, port the hot functions with your coding agent, prove they behave the same. Python, JS/TS, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, Go, PHP, C/C++, C#, R.
items.purpose: Tìm và viết lại các đoạn code chạy chậm để tăng tốc ứng dụng

items.name: fxceless/victory-fork
items.description: Work-in-progress fork of VIctory: getting an Xbox Series title to render and run on a Windows PC. No game files.
items.purpose: Bản fork đang phát triển để chạy một tựa game Xbox Series trên PC Windows

items.name: ProjectLeonida/mandy
items.description: A continuation of Leonida, the Xbox > PC port interface for GTA VI
items.purpose: Giao diện tiếp nối Leonida, hỗ trợ đưa GTA VI từ Xbox lên PC

items.name: trustno1-coder/VIctory-NVIDIA
items.description: VIctory (Xbox Series compatibility layer) tuned for NVIDIA RTX cards: Series X at 2560x1440 with DLSS, about 26-30 fps on an RTX 5070, DLSS frame generation 2x-6x, an F1 settings menu and F3 stats panel, open water without dark blocks. Built on many repos combined into one. No game files or NVIDIA files included.
items.purpose: Lớp tương thích Xbox Series được tinh chỉnh để chạy trên card NVIDIA RTX
